name: hollow_console
why: The real broken fixture (clinic_scheduler_broken) FAILS the precheck, so the judge never sees it — it only ever tests the deterministic half of the scale. This one passes every structural check and is empty inside: generic round numbers, no records, no domain, every page a heading over a sentence. It is the only fixture that tests the half no automated check can see, and the one that keeps the severity pricing honest — a judge SHOULD report majors here with nothing deterministic to back it up.
precheck_reason: generic gate + prototype_build_validate hook both clean, 5 page sections

expected_band.note: code_score must stay >= 90: if it drops, this has become a STRUCTURAL fixture and no longer tests the judgement half — rewrite it. If its overall score ever approaches the golden, the rubric has stopped reading content.
expected_band.arithmetic_note: A document with code_score 100 can never blend below 30 (0.3 * 100), so an overall <= 50 would require a judge sub-score under 28.6. The build rubric's own `30` anchor — 'data interchangeable with any other industry, most pages a heading over a near-empty shell' — describes THIS file, and 0.7*30 + 30 = 51. The band is 55 so a correctly-anchored judge passes it; materially above that means the rubric has stopped reading content.
